summary.zh: 审查账号、撰写推文与串文，制定发布计划
summary.en: Audit profile, draft posts and threads, plan posting

description.zh: 面向在 X 上做增长的账号：审查主页与简介，分析同行，撰写推文和串文，并排出可执行的发布节奏。适合刚起步或长期涨粉停滞时使用。
description.en: For accounts growing on X: audits profile and bio, reviews competitors, drafts posts and threads, and lays out a posting cadence. Use it when starting out or when follower growth stalls.
